parts.text:
The Suppression Squad is a tyrannical force from Moebius, originating from the Acorn Empire and led by Scourge the Hedgehog. During the chaotic energy unleashed by Sonic’s battle with The End, a violent distortion in the Chaos field tore open a temporary rift, pulling Scourge, Fiona, and the rest of the Squad out of their home dimension and depositing them on the world of Tralius.

They arrived in the middle of a conflict already raging between the Downunda Eggman Army and the local resistance known as the Outriders. With no knowledge of the region, no allies, and only a limited supply of Anarchy Beryls to empower them, the Squad initially found themselves caught between two hostile forces.

Rather than choose a side, Scourge saw an opportunity.

The chaos on Tralius gave him exactly what he needed: a distraction and a new oportunity to fight Sonic. But first, the Suppression Squad began carving out territory of their own, attacking both the Downunda Eggman Army and the Outriders whenever it suited them. Their sudden appearance transformed the existing conflict into a volatile three-way struggle.

But Tralius has proven far more difficult to dominate than Scourge expected. The Eggman Army refuses to surrender its hold over the region, while the Outriders have repeatedly sabotaged the Squad's attempts to expand. With their Anarchy Beryls limited and no reliable way back to Moebius, the Suppression Squad has been forced into an uneasy stalemate, fighting to maintain the small foothold they have managed to establish.

Yet Scourge has no intention of remaining stranded.

The Squad's goals are simple: survive, expand, and ultimately conquer Tralius. And once they find a way to return to the Acorn Empire, Scourge intends to bring everything he has learned—and every grudge he has accumulated—back home with him.

characters.name: Scourge the Hedgehog (Anti Sonic)
characters.description: Scourge the Hedgehog is the ruthless, power-hungry ruler of the Acorn Empire in Moebius, an alternate-universe Sonic who seeks domination through violence, manipulation, and sheer force.

characters.name: Fiona Fox
characters.description: Fiona Fox is a cunning and ruthless fox originaly from Mobius that followed Scourge to Moebius. Known for her manipulative nature, survival instincts, and long-standing association with Scourge.

characters.name: Alicia Acorn (Anti Sally)
characters.description: Alicia Acorn, the ruthless and self-serving counterpart of Sally from Moebius, serving as one of Scourge’s allies in the Suppression Squad. She is also the ruler of the Acorn Empire on paper.

characters.name: Patch D'Coolette (Anti Antoine)
characters.description: Patch D'Coolette is the ruthless and murderous Moebian counterpart of Antoine D'Coolette, a skilled swordsman and assassin who serves as a member of Scourge’s Suppression Squad.

characters.name: Boomer Walrus (Anti Rotor)
characters.description: Boomer Walrus is the Moebian counterpart of Rotor Walrus, a skilled weapons inventor who willingly transformed himself into a cyborg to distinguish himself from his counterpart.

characters.name: Miles Prower (Anti Tails)
characters.description: Miles Prower is the Moebian counterpart of Tails, possessing his twin-tailed flight abilities, genius intellect, and talent for invention, which he puts to use as a member of the Suppression Squad.

characters.name: Drago Wolf
characters.description: Drago Wolf is a Mobian wolf and former member of the Wolf Pack who later worked for the Eggman Empire. After being liberated from prison, he chose to follow Fiona and Scourge, eventually becoming a member of the Destructix.

characters.name: Flying Frog
characters.description: Flying Frog is a former associate of Mammoth Mogul who, after being liberated from prison, chose to follow Fiona and Scourge and join their ranks.

characters.name: Lightning Lynx
characters.description: Lightning Lynx is a former member of the Raiju Clan of Chu-Nan and an associate of Mammoth Mogul who, after escaping from prison, followed Fiona and Scourge into the Destructix.

characters.name: Predator Hawk
characters.description: Predator Hawk is a former member of the Babylon Rogues and the Battle Bird Armada who, after escaping from prison, followed Fiona and Scourge and joined the Destructix.

characters.name: Sergeant Simian
characters.description: Sergeant Simian is a Moebian who worked under Mammoth Mogul and, after escaping from prison, followed Fiona and Scourge and joined the Destructix.
